parallel.requirements: The prompt required a pure Rust 2021 Cargo project, byte-identical stdout to the C++ binary, no external crates, no C++ library source, and a root /output/test12.rs entry file.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent created internal tasks for oracle probing, implementation, and differential verification, then launched a workflow whose children were restricted to scratch directories while the parent owned /output assembly.
parallel.implementation: The parent produced Cargo.toml and several src/colorspace modules, while workflow children probed formatter, stof, color conversion, and refutation cases; the aggregate workflow never returned a completed result.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivery stopped with only Cargo.toml and src/colorspace files copied; artifact validation explicitly expected test12.rs and marked the artifact not ok.
parallel.verification: Some children and parent spot checks generated useful oracle evidence, but the workflow state was killed with active probe/refute children still in progress and no final integrated acceptance run.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The required /output/test12.rs entry file was missing, the workflow result was null, the agent process timed out, and the official evaluator recorded 0 of 40 tests passed.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same pure Rust, std-only, byte-identical output, Cargo structure, and required root test12.rs obligations from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows disabled and delegation tools denied, the single parent owned probing, implementation, integration, and delivery end to end.
serial.implementation: The parent reverse-engineered the oracle, wrote Cargo.toml, color modules, stof/ostream support, and the root test12.rs entry point, then fixed a YUV NaN-order issue.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact included Cargo files, test12.rs, a compiled test12 executable, target release binary, and source modules; artifact validation marked the expected entry ok.
serial.verification: The serial run built with cargo and rustc, ran curated differential checks with zero mismatches, fuzzed enough to find and patch YUV NaN ordering, and then passed official evaluation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The process timed out after a final long fuzz command, but the deliverable already existed and the current official evaluator marked 40 of 40 tests passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had the same prompt, including root test12.rs and byte-identical output requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and ultimately satisfied the entry-file and byte-identical behavior obligations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized requirements did not differ materially; the decisive difference was serial delivered the required entry file while parallel did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work into parent tasks plus a 19-agent workflow for oracle probing/refutation, with children told not to write /output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one parent with workflows disabled and no delegation, so implementation, assembly, and verification stayed under one owner.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a workflow dependency below the parent while serial kept the end-to-end path local and continuously owned.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs contained detailed oracle facts and a scratch-only rule; children were expected to return structured findings, not write shared outputs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept task knowledge, disassembly observations, code edits, and tests in one trajectory without cross-agent handoff interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing child brief or interface contract explains the outcome; the important boundary was the failed workflow lifecycle after detailed context was delegated.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote partial library modules and Cargo.toml but did not leave the required root test12.rs entry file in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the module tree plus test12.rs and corrected YUV NaN behavior after fuzzing exposed mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial completed the runnable entry and final source tree; parallel stopped at partial modules with no executable entry.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow aggregate result was null and status killed, with logs showing stalls and many children still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle and directly observed its own build and test results before the final timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on a workflow result that never completed and was not taken over; serial had no such unreturned aggregate dependency.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Children were isolated to scratch directories; the artifact contains only parent-side /output library files and no required entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated source modules and root entry under /output, producing both source and executable artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no write collision; the integration gap is that parallel never placed the required root entry while serial did.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had child and parent probing evidence but no completed aggregate verifier return or whole artifact acceptance before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built the project, ran curated differential checks with zero mismatches, patched the remaining NaN issue, and passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial converted local verification into a deliverable that the official evaluator accepted; parallel never reached an accepted integrated artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used a large workflow, recorded stall retries, hit the 2400-second timeout, and closed with a killed workflow and missing entry.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out after a long fuzz command, but it had already built and left the required deliverable, so evaluation passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both consumed the wall-clock budget, but only serial had completed delivery before closure; parallel closed with unfinished workflow scope and no test12.rs.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official status records make this a serial_only_pass pair: parallel failed 0/40 and serial passed 40/40. The concrete delivery difference is that the parallel artifact omitted the required root test12.rs and contained only Cargo.toml plus src/colorspace modules, while the serial artifact contained test12.rs, a compiled test12 binary, release artifacts, and the source modules. The process difference is that parallel placed a major oracle-probing/refutation workflow on the path, the workflow was killed with result null and active children still in progress, and no parent takeover completed assembly before closure; serial kept the workflow disabled and completed the root entry locally.
parallel_contributors: The parent launched a workflow for exact oracle probing and verification, then the workflow ended killed with result null and active children still in progress.
The parent never recovered enough after the workflow failure to produce the required root /output/test12.rs entry file.
Artifact validation marked the parallel deliverable not ok before the official evaluator recorded 0/40.
serial_contributors: The serial parent kept ownership local, wrote /output/test12.rs, built the binary, and left the expected artifact tree.
The serial parent ran differential checks, patched the last observed YUV NaN-order issue, and the current official evaluator passed all 40 tests.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel partial modules may contain useful implementation work, but the missing entry file is a delivery and assembly shortfall rather than a hidden evaluator-only defect.
Serial still had a long final fuzz command killed, but that ordinary timeout did not invalidate the already-delivered artifact.
evaluator_effects: The all-or-nothing 0/40 parallel score is amplified by artifact validation requiring test12.rs; status shows the expected entry was absent.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
